{{Conjecture|legends}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''black market dealer''' operated in the [[Zarkis system/Legends|Zarkis system]]. The dealer came into possession of a [[Unidentified alien weapon|weapon of alien origin]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] sent a team to acquire the weapon and negotiate with the dealer.<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
